page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top with page number at top right; catchword "Q" and "Poë-" at the foot of the column. Left margin holds show-through from the facing page and a digitiser's cover (ignored). No marginal notes readable.

main_text.p: perationibus & effectis, ejus, cum à voluntate, tum à sensibus distinctione, fusa,confusa commini-scentes : Ita præoccupantibus omnia,&in caput ac primam partem suorum commentariorū attrahentibus,præter jejuna quædam & rancida, vix suppetit in progressu, quod dicant, tamquam exhausti jam & marcidi : Edentes profecto fungis quibusdā quam simillimos tractatus : Quibus amplus quidem pro capite bulbus obtigit; cæterum exiguus caudex & nulla radix.

Quidam, ut id incommodi devitent, infestant tertiam Cloacam, ad Rhapsodias, inquam, se conferunt, & ex his affatim hauriunt, quo res suas, alioqui tenues & exiles infarciant. Hi pro re nata, varias Historias narrant, lepidas Fabellas admiscent, Versus etiam sæpe citant è Poë-

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page visible in the left margin; ignored. Catchword "Q" at the foot may be a signature mark; the word "Poë-" is taken as the catchword.
